ja.oneLiner: Zeiro（税路）は、1人法人・マイクロ法人向けの統合経理・給与・決算クラウドSaaSです。取引メールの無人自動連携とGemini AI自動仕訳、役員報酬・社会保険計算、源泉税「納期の特例」集計までを年額¥9,360（月換算¥780）で提供します。
ja.targetAudience: 日本の1人法人・マイクロ法人・複数法人オーナー
ja.pricingSummary: Free ¥0 / Pro 年額¥9,360（月¥980） / Business 年額¥23,760
ja.dataStorage: Cloudflare D1/R2上の暗号化テナント分離保管（TLS 1.3）
ja.compliance: 複式簿記・協会けんぽ（東京支部）標準報酬月額・国税庁源泉徴収税額表・電子帳簿保存法対応証憑保管（Business）
features: 取引通知メール（GMOあおぞら・住信SBI・SMBC・AMEX等）からの無人明細収集とSHA-256重複排除
Gemini Flash AIによる勘定科目・税区分の自動仕訳推論
役員報酬・従業員給与・社会保険料・源泉所得税の自動計算と明細出力
年2回（1月・7月）の源泉所得税「納期の特例」集計表の自動生成
STAGEN 9大決算健全性監査とMoney Forward仕訳帳CSV無損失インポート

faqs.q: Zeiro（税路）とはどのようなサービスですか？
faqs.a: 1人法人・マイクロ法人に特化した統合経理・給与・決算SaaSです。複式簿記帳簿、取引通知メール自動連携、Gemini AI仕訳推論、役員給与・社会保険計算、源泉税「納期の特例」集計、STAGEN 9大決算健全性監査までをワンストップで提供します。

faqs.q: Money Forward クラウドや freee との違いは何ですか？
faqs.a: 大企業向けの複雑な設定や過剰な多機能を省き、1人法人に必要な業務へ絞り込むことで、プロプラン年額¥9,360（月額換算¥780）という従来比1/3〜1/4の価格を実現しています。追加契約なしで役員給与計算や源泉税特例集計も含まれます。

faqs.q: 既存のMoney Forwardクラウドからデータを移行できますか？
faqs.a: はい。Money Forward クラウド会計からエクスポートした「仕訳帳 CSV」をインポートすることで、過去の仕訳データを移行初日から引き継げます。

faqs.q: 取引通知メールの自動連携はどのように動作しますか？
faqs.a: ネット銀行やクレジットカードの決済通知メールを連携すると、金額・日付・取引先を自動抽出し、SHA-256指紋による重複排除を行ったうえで仕訳候補を生成します。

faqs.q: AI仕訳で送信したデータはAIの学習に使われますか？
faqs.a: いいえ。Google Gemini APIの利用規約に基づき、勘定科目・税区分の推論のみに使用され、モデルの学習や再利用には使用されません。

en.name: Zeiro
en.oneLiner: Zeiro is an integrated cloud accounting, payroll, and closing SaaS built specifically for Japanese micro-corporations (1-person companies). It combines zero-touch transaction email sync, Gemini AI journal entry inference, director payroll and withholding tax reporting starting at ¥9,360/year (¥780/month equivalent).
en.targetAudience: Solo corporations (micro-corporations) and small entity owners in Japan
en.dataStorage: Tenant-isolated encrypted storage on Cloudflare D1/R2 (TLS 1.3)
en.compliance: Double-entry bookkeeping, Kyokai Kenpo Tokyo grade tables, NTA withholding tax tables, e-Bookkeeping receipt archive (Business)
features: Zero-touch transaction email ingestion (GMO Aozora, SBI Sumishin, SMBC, AMEX) with SHA-256 deduplication
Gemini Flash AI account and tax-category journal inference
Director compensation, payroll, social insurance, and withholding tax calculation
One-click semi-annual withholding tax special schedule (Jan/Jul) aggregation
9-point year-end health audit and lossless Money Forward journal CSV import

faqs.q: What is Zeiro?
faqs.a: Zeiro is an all-in-one accounting, payroll, and closing SaaS tailored for 1-person Japanese corporations, covering double-entry bookkeeping, automated email transaction ingestion, Gemini AI journal suggestions, director payroll, withholding tax reports, and closing health checks.

faqs.q: How does Zeiro compare to Money Forward Cloud or freee?
faqs.a: By focusing strictly on what micro-corporations actually need, Zeiro offers accounting plus payroll and withholding tax reporting at ¥9,360/year—roughly 1/3 to 1/4 the combined cost of enterprise-oriented suites.

faqs.q: Can I migrate existing data from Money Forward?
faqs.a: Yes. You can import exported Money Forward journal CSV files directly into Zeiro without losing historical entries.

faqs.q: Is my accounting data used to train AI models?
faqs.a: No. Under Gemini API terms, transaction details are processed solely for journal inference and are not used to train or improve AI models.

ko.oneLiner: Zeiro(세로)는 일본 1인 법인·마이크로 법인에 특화된 통합 회계·급여·결산 클라우드 SaaS입니다. 거래 알림 메일 무인 연동, Gemini AI 자동 분개, 임원보수·사회보험 계산 및 원천세 납기특례 집계까지 연 ¥9,360(월 환산 ¥780)으로 제공합니다.

faqs.q: Zeiro는 어떤 서비스인가요?
faqs.a: 일본 1인 법인에 필요한 복식부기, 거래 메일 자동 수집, Gemini AI 분개 추론, 임원 급여·사회보험 계산, 원천세 납기특례 집계, 결산 건전성 감사까지 하나로 제공하는 통합 SaaS입니다.

faqs.q: Money Forward나 freee와 어떤 차이가 있나요?
faqs.a: 대기업용 복잡한 설정을 빼고 1인 법인 실무에 집중해, 급여 계산과 원천세 특례 집계를 포함하고도 연 ¥9,360(기존 대비 1/3~1/4 수준)의 요금으로 이용할 수 있습니다.

faqs.q: 기존 Money Forward 분개 데이터를 옮길 수 있나요?
faqs.a: 네. Money Forward 클라우드 회계에서 내보낸 분개장 CSV 파일을 그대로 임포트하여 과거 장부를 이어서 관리할 수 있습니다.

faqs.q: AI 분개 추론에 사용된 거래 데이터가 모델 학습에 쓰이나요?
faqs.a: 아니요. Gemini API 이용 약관에 따라 계정과목 추론 목적에만 사용되며 AI 모델 학습에 재사용되지 않습니다.

en.name: Rakubill

features: Quotes, delivery notes, invoices, and receipt PDFs with one-tap quote-to-invoice conversion
Qualified Invoice registration number and 8%/10%/tax-exempt calculation
Partial payment tracking and free due-date reminders (3 days before, due date, 1 day after)

Sales CSV export for manual import into freee, Money Forward, or Yayoi

faqs.q: Does Rakubill support Japan's Qualified Invoice System?
faqs.a: Yes. You can configure your Qualified Invoice Issuer Registration Number and assign 8% reduced, 10% standard, or tax-exempt rates per line item.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the free tier and Mobile Premium?
faqs.a: The free tier includes unlimited quotes and up to 3 invoices/delivery notes per month. Mobile Premium is a ¥500 one-time purchase unlocking unlimited invoices and CSV exports.

faqs.q: What extra features does the Web version offer?
faqs.a: The Web app (rakubill.sta3e-n.online) supports PC browser workflows, direct email delivery with 60-day secure PDF download links, and negative line items starting at ¥980/month.

faqs.q: Where is my invoice data stored?
faqs.a: On mobile, all client and invoice data stays strictly on your device and works offline. On the Web app, data is stored in your cloud account.

faqs.q: ZeiCalの無料版とProの違いは何ですか？

faqs.q: 税金シミュレータは確定申告書の作成に使えますか？

faqs.q: 税務データはサーバーに送信されますか？

faqs.q: 請求書作成や会計記帳もできますか？

faqs.a: All company settings and tax checklists stay strictly on your device with no server sync or account signup required.

faqs.q: Does ZeiCal handle invoicing or bookkeeping?
